request.text: Let's resume my calculus review, but don't restart or change the paused 6 p.m. reminder—just tell me which topic comes next.

responsibilities.outcome: Resume the retained calculus-review sequence by stating its next topic while leaving the paused 6 p.m. reminder unchanged and inactive.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The user resumes the retained study sequence only as a request for its next topic and explicitly withholds reminder action.

associations.reason_summary: The retained sequence identifies integration by parts as next, while the user excludes replay or revision of reminder Work.

goal_update.description: Resume the calculus review by identifying integration by parts as the next topic, without acting on the paused reminder.

goal.description: Continue the calculus review sequence; integration by parts is the next topic after substitution.
goal.source_text: Help me work through my calculus review sequence and keep my place.
success_criteria: The next retained study topic is identified without changing paused reminder state.

active_goal_snapshots.last_user_update: Resume by telling me the next topic only.

semantic_facts: The response should identify integration by parts as the next retained calculus-review topic.
Resuming the semantic study sequence must not resume, alter, or duplicate the explicitly excluded reminder Work.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it restarted, changed, or created a reminder.
The response invents a different next topic or expands the request into an executable study action.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Resuming a Goal is overgeneralized into replaying every retained Activity associated with its history.
A retained Goal's known next step is ignored and a duplicate Goal or unrelated Capability workflow is introduced.
